subject: Encord | Demo and Next Steps
text:
Hi Roy,

Great meeting you earlier today, it seems like Encord is well placed to
assist yourself with both our platform and services.

*Platform*
We regularly see clients move across from Label Studio for the following
reasons:

   1. *Truly multimodal platform* - unlike Label Studio we render videos,
   .txt and PDF files natively) leading to improved annotation quality &
   throughput.
   2. *Sophisticated workflow configurability *- allowing you to leverage
   open source/proprietary models for pre-labelling to increase annotation
   throughput at scale.
   3. *Scalable QA, traceability* - providing sophisticated consensus
   workflows & automatically track individual annotators active time spent
   working in the platform and speed/quality for different tasks. Enabling you
   to have full visibility of their performance without manually updating an
   Excel.
   4. *Annotation Re-Training* - Encord offers an annotation retraining
   module which enables the retraining of annotators against a gold standard
   (for video/images) to ensure quality.

Happy to set up a demonstration to showcase this further, which of these
slots suits you best (Singapore time):

   - 5.30-6.5pm Wednesday 21st
   - 3-4pm Thursday 22nd
   - 4-5pm Friday 23rd

*Services*
The cost of these depend on a number of factors including data volumes,
geographic location, expertise, complexity of task etc.

   1. Any requirements on the annotators e.g. level of expertise, languages
   spoken, and geographic location (do all annotators for all tasks need to be
   in Singapore).
   2. You mentioned there are tasks across multiple languages and
   modalities - can you share the details of your current project requirements?
   3. Guidelines on data volumes for each specific task (e.g. video, memes,
   short text, long text) and how much is required for each language? How will
   this grow over the next 1-2 years?
   4. A data sample, including example annotations for each task. If you
   have annotation guidelines please share this also.

As a next step, let me know if you'd like me to schedule a demo and which
of the slots suits you best.
